APPENDIX D Continued

NOTES:
Step 5 is calculated by dividing Step 1 of BA on the regular salary scheduled by 188 days.

2. Reserve teachers who substitute on long term assignment 30 consecutive teaching days, will receive 1 day of sick leave for each 30 days worked.

3. Reserve teachers may participate in the District 281 Staff Development program. They can obtain a course booklet by picking them up at the Central Office or by calling and requesting that a copy be mailed to them.
